title: Global Diamond Inclusion Database: prototype
description_html:
Early prototype. Published Stachel compilations loaded as-is for browsing, with readable column names. Not yet curated into the project schema; values not yet checked against the original papers.

Use the search box for localities, minerals, sample IDs or references; click a facet value to filter; click a column heading to sort.

Quick links: Inclusions only (skips diamond-only rows) · Kankan superdeep diamonds · Lower-mantle inclusions · Summary by locality · Summary by reference · Trace elements
source: Stachel (2021), Borealis; see Stachel, Aulbach & Harris (2022) RiMG 88

major_elements.title: Inclusions: major elements + host diamonds
major_elements.description: One row = one inclusion analysis, with its host diamond's data repeated. Source: Stachel Diamond Inclusion Database, Oct 2021 (doi:10.7939/DVN/EJUE1G).

columns.Locality: Pipe, prospect or alluvial district, as given in the original paper.
columns.Craton / terrane: Craton or terrane, as assigned in the compilation.
columns.Inclusion mineral: Phase for this analysis, as labelled in the compilation (e.g. MgSiO3 = likely former bridgmanite).
columns.Sample ID: Sample number from the original study (some zero-padded by the compiler).
columns.Paragenesis: Plain-language form of simple codes only; combined or uncertain codes are left blank, see the code column.
columns.Paragenesis (code): Compiler code: e eclogitic, p peridotitic, h harzburgitic, l lherzolitic, wb websteritic, l.m. lower mantle, deep- sublithospheric.
columns.Garnet class: Grütter et al. (2004) class, calculated by the compiler from garnet chemistry.
columns.Assemblage in diamond: All inclusion phases reported in this diamond.
columns.Diamond size: As reported: sieve class (e.g. -11+9), mm, µm or mg.
columns.Diamond shape: o octahedral, d dodecahedral, c cuboid, co cubo-octahedron, m macle, a aggregate, f fragment, i irregular.
columns.Diamond colour: c colourless, y yellow, br brown, gn green, pk pink; l light, d dark.
columns.Diamond type (FTIR): II, Ib, IaA, IaB, IaAB from FTIR nitrogen content and aggregation.
columns.Oxide total (wt%): Blank oxide cells usually mean not analysed; b.d. / <x mean below detection.

inclusions_per_locality.title: Summary: inclusion analyses per locality
inclusions_per_locality.sql:
select "Locality", "Craton / terrane", count(*) as "Analyses",
 count(distinct "Inclusion data reference" || '|' || coalesce("Sample ID", '')) as "Approx. diamonds",
 count(distinct "Inclusion data reference") as "References"
from major_elements where "Inclusion mineral" is not null and "Inclusion mineral" <> ''
group by 1, 2 order by "Analyses" desc
inclusions_per_locality.description: Approx. diamonds counts distinct reference + sample ID pairs, so it is only an estimate.

rows_per_reference.title: Summary: rows per source reference
rows_per_reference.sql:
select "Inclusion data reference" as "Reference", "Inclusion data DOI" as "DOI", count(*) as "Rows",
 group_concat(distinct "Locality") as "Localities"
from major_elements group by 1, 2 order by "Rows" desc
